# oci-containers

## virtualisation.oci-containers.containers

OCI containers, each run by a launchd agent of the primary user, through apple-container.

*Type:*
attribute set of (submodule)

*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```

*Example:*

```nix
{
  nginx = {
    image = "nginx:latest";
    ports = [ "127.0.0.1:8080:80" ];
  };
}

```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix)

## virtualisation.oci-containers.containers.\<name>.apple-container.onDemand.enable

Start the container on the first connection to one of
`ports`, and stop it after `idleTimeout`
without one. launchd owns the listeners, so they are up
while the container is not; each connection waits for the
container, then is bridged to the container’s own address.

Turns `autoStart` and `keepAlive` off.

*Type:*
boolean

*Default:*

```nix
false
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix)

## virtualisation.oci-containers.containers.\<name>.apple-container.onDemand.idleTimeout

Seconds since the last connection opened or closed after
which the container is stopped; never while a connection, or
a `container exec`/`attach`, is open. It is
checked every minute, so 0 stops the container at the first
check without one.

*Type:*
unsigned integer, meaning >=0

*Default:*

```nix
1800
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix)

## virtualisation.oci-containers.containers.\<name>.apple-container.onDemand.ports

TCP listeners, `[hostIP:]hostPort:containerPort`: on every
address without a hostIP. Not in `ports`, which would
take the same host port.

*Type:*
list of string

*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```

*Example:*

```nix
[
  "127.0.0.1:2222:22"
]
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix)

## virtualisation.oci-containers.containers.\<name>.apple-container.onDemand.startTimeout

Seconds a connection waits for the container to answer, e.g. through a first image pull.

*Type:*
positive integer, meaning >0

*Default:*

```nix
300
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix)

## virtualisation.oci-containers.containers.\<name>.apple-container.virtualization

Expose virtualization to the container, e.g. `/dev/kvm`
(`--virtualization`). The container fails to start on a host
without nested virtualization (before M3), and needs a kernel
with `CONFIG_KVM`, such as `apple-container-kernel`.

*Type:*
boolean

*Default:*

```nix
false
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/virtualisation/oci-containers/default.nix)
